title: Stone Visage and the Golden Line
description: A cracked stone face looks upward with closed eyes, split by a thin glowing line of golden light. One half crumbles into dark rock in this striking, minimal desktop artwork.

title: Eclipse Over a Violet Sea
description: A delicate eclipse ring hangs in a starry night sky between soft clouds tinted pink and blue. Its glow falls across the rolling ocean below in this calm, cool-toned desktop scene.

title: Glowing Gate in the Dunes
description: A lone traveler walks across dark sand dunes toward a tall rectangular gate outlined in warm glowing light. Dust and haze catch the amber light in this quiet, cinematic desktop wallpaper.
